accepted.quote: A strong, non-partisan federal workforce is fundamental to a functioning democratic government. These dedicated workers deserve our respect and support.
accepted.rationale: The quote affirms support for a non-partisan federal workforce and respect for its workers.

accepted.quote: This legislation would also change the annuity formula to base most employees' annual retirement payments on their highest five years of earnings, instead of the highest three-- an outright theft of earned benefits that would cost federal retirees thousands of dollars annually.
accepted.rationale: The quote condemns the annuity formula change as theft of earned benefits harming retirees.

accepted.quote: Worst of all, Republicans are seeking to offset these costs by gutting $800 billion from the Medicaid program. My Democratic colleagues and I do not support that.
accepted.rationale: The quote explicitly opposes cutting $800 billion from Medicaid.
